died.name: Nero
died.cause: to a soldier trying to save him after his suicide
died.last_words: Too late; is this your fidelity?

died.name: Charles Dickens
died.cause: to his sister-in-law Georgina Hogarth, who had suggested he lie down after he suffered a stroke

died.name: Max Aitken, 1st Baron Beaverbrook
died.cause: Canadian-British newspaper publisher, at his 85th birthday party held 15 days before his death
died.last_words: This is my final word. It is time for me to become an apprentice once more. I have not settled in which direction.

died.name: Franco Brun
died.cause: The 22-year-old inmate from Toronto being held at the Metro Toronto East Detention Centre in Scarborough, Ontario, died while trying to swallow a pocket-size Bible.

died.name: Lee Han-yeol
died.cause: to his classmates at a demonstration before being shot by a tear gas container. Fell into a coma and never regained consciousness before his death on 5 July
died.last_words: I have to go to City Hall tomorrow.

born.name: Leopold I, Holy Roman Emperor
born.last_words: Let me die to the sound of sweet music.

born.name: Johnny Ace
born.cause: American musician, playing with a .32 caliber revolver
born.last_words: I'll show you that it won't shoot.
